description: Header file defining the ExceptionHandler class for handling exceptions and generating minidumps on Solaris in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Class responsible for handling exceptions, signals, and writing minidump files for crash reporting.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Immediately writes a minidump file capturing the current execution state.

methods.name: set_dump_path
methods.description: Sets the directory path where minidumps will be stored.
